descriptors.R: the sitting President, nominee of the party that holds the White House and both houses of Congress
descriptors.D: nominee of the party out of power since 2001; a sitting senator from a New England state

compile_desc.R: the party that holds the White House and both houses of Congress
compile_desc.D: the party out of power since 2001

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including an independent, a Libertarian and a Green nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Bush, Kerry, Cheney, Edwards, Dean, Clark, Lieberman, Gephardt, Nader, Camejo, Badnarik, Cobb or Clinton

slice_sources.men: 2000 census and 2005 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) interpolated to November 2004; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2004); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2004 returns.
slice_sources.women: 2000 census and 2005 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) interpolated to November 2004; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2004); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2004 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 2000 census and 2005 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) interpolated to November 2004; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2004); calibrated to the certified 2004 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 2000 census and 2005 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) interpolated to November 2004; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2004), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 2004 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 2000 census and 2005 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) interpolated to November 2004; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the party out of power
